label: SXT LTE6 kit
description: MikroTik SXT LTE6 kit (SXTR&FG621-EA) — 2x 100M RJ45, LTE radio. MIPSBE 1-core QCA9531.
notes: Power method from the mikrotik.com spec table: **PoE in: 802.3af/at** (12-57 V) on `eth1`; **PoE out on `eth2`** - it powers the device above it on the mast or the AP on the wall, and the port is the vendor's own, not a convention. Input is recorded on the first Ethernet port because the table states the method and voltage but does not name the port, and every MikroTik with a PoE-IN DC input takes it there. Max power consumption not stated.
